title: cw task assign --input
description: A worker brief, bound to the current source. cw also checks rules this schema does not state, such as the stage's round cap.

id.description: The assignment ID, unique in the task.

owned_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the worker may change; . is the whole repository.

bundle.description: The filled reviewer bundle; review briefs only.

contract.description: The saved Go contract extract; implementation briefs only.

inputs.description: Files handed to the worker; cw keeps a copy of each.

requirements.description: The contract requirements a brief with a contract covers.

stage.description: Under a profile, an implementation or review brief needs one of the profile's stages.

fixes.description: The findings or requirements a later round of an author stage answers.

repeats.description: The earlier assignment of the same stage this one replaces.
